meta_description:
32K likes, 1,385 comments - chatgpt on July 9, 2026: "This is the new ChatGPT Work.

Powered Codex and GPT-5.6, it’s a whole new way to get work done.

It can now understand your goals, use context from selected apps and files, create polished documents, decks, analyses, sites, and reports, and keep work moving while you stay in control.

You can just describe the outcome you want without needing to outline every step to get there.

The new ChatGPT desktop app will be available globally starting today to all users on Mac and Windows.

Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu users will also be able to use the new experience on web and mobile at launch.".
